title: The CR's own examples, chapter 5 (Turn Structure)
blind: Written from the CR text, printed card text and rulings (the lookup skill) only. The engine's src/, tests and baselines were not read. Committed before the comparison for this batch existed.
defaults: Unless a case says otherwise: the Runner has the default 4 MU and no link, both identities are blank, servers have no ice, the Corp has 5 credits and the Runner 5, zones not mentioned hold only cards with no relevant abilities, and the Corp declines to rez or use anything not listed in the steps.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 4 clicks, 5 credits. Professional Contacts is installed. The grip is empty and the stack holds at least 3 cards. HQ has no ice.

steps.label: use
steps.do: The Runner uses Professional Contacts as an action.

steps.label: in-run
steps.do: The Runner then runs HQ and, in the paid ability window of the initiation phase, tries to use Professional Contacts.

expect.why: Its cost begins with a click, so it is an action, and an action is taken only in an action window.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 4 clicks. A rezzed Eli 1.0 is the only ice protecting HQ. The Runner has no icebreakers.

steps.label: break
steps.do: The Runner runs HQ, encounters Eli 1.0 and, in the encounter's paid ability window, uses 'Lose click: Break 1 subroutine' twice.

steps.label: run-over
steps.do: No subroutine resolves, the Runner passes Eli 1.0 and the run ends.

expect.why: 'Lose click' is a cost with a click symbol that does not begin with one, so the ability is not an action and is used in a paid ability window.
One click for the run, two lost to break.

cases.position: Runner's turn, 4 clicks, 5 credits. The grip holds Stimhack and two other cards. Archives is empty and has no ice.

steps.label: in-run
steps.do: The Runner plays Stimhack and runs Archives. Read during the run, before it ends.

steps.label: mid-action
steps.do: During that run the Runner tries to take another action, the basic action to gain 1 credit.

steps.label: done
steps.do: The run ends, the Runner suffers 1 core damage and Stimhack is trashed.

expect.why: The 'play an event' action is not complete until the run and what follows it are done, so no new action window has opened.
Two cards left after playing Stimhack, one trashed by the core damage.
Not a standard key: core damage the Runner has suffered.
The 9 credits were on Stimhack, not in the pool, and are gone with it.

cases.position: Corp's turn, 3 clicks, 5 credits. The Corp's identity is MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration. HQ holds Hedge Fund and Lateral Growth.

steps.label: third
steps.do: The Corp plays Hedge Fund, then plays Lateral Growth without installing a card, then takes the basic action to gain 1 credit.

expect.why: Not a standard key: whether MirrorMorph's ability is offered after the third action. Both plays used the same basic action, so the first two actions were not different.

cases.position: Corp's turn, 3 clicks, 5 credits. The Corp's identity is MirrorMorph: Endless Iteration. HQ holds Hedge Fund.

steps.label: third
steps.do: The Corp plays Hedge Fund, takes the basic action to gain 1 credit, then takes the basic action to draw 1 card. For MirrorMorph the Corp chooses to gain 1 credit.

expect.why: Not a standard key: whether MirrorMorph's ability is offered after the third action. Three different basic actions.
